newsitem.title: USA: Timken says seeks early union contract.
newsitem.headline: Timken says seeks early union contract.

text.p: Timken Co said Tuesday if it does not reach an early agreement with its United Steel Workers union members there could be a potentially material effect on the company's financial performance and the stability of work for its associates.
The company said there are 4,500 union members among its 19,000 associates.
Timken said it has been negotiating the contract, which expires in late September, and aims to reach early agreement in order to offer an uninterrupted supply of products.
Although the parties continue to negotiate, no agreement has yet been reached, Timken said.

Timken posted first-quarter results of net sales of $640.6 million, up from $596 million reported last year. First quarter net income totaled $41.1 million, or $1.32 per share, compared with $33.6 million, or $1.07 per share.
Timken shares rose one to 53-7/8 in late morning trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
